**Coaching note:**
Look for forcing moves first! Checks and captures immediately limit your opponent's options. Here, Rh1+ forces White's hand before advancing the passed pawn. When you have a dangerous passed pawn plus an active rook, combine them with forcing moves to create unstoppable threats the opponent must abandon material to stop.
